scenarios.name: happy-path-full-run
scenarios.prompt: Scope a new GTM motion for Brite Supply in the HOA landscape lighting domain. Run the full 5-phase workflow.
scenarios.expected_output: Should check docs/marketing-context.md first. Should confirm entity = brite-supply. Should run all 5 phases sequentially: Phase 1 research (fallback to WebSearch since account-research not shipped), Phase 2 TAM segments (3-10, weighted scoring with Fit x2), Phase 3 deep dive (3 personas + 5-8 PQS signals per segment, SF-grounded), Phase 4 messaging pillars (2-3 per segment + offer tier + PQS triggers, NO COPY), Phase 5 output. Should write artifact to docs/strategy/supply-hoa-landscape-lighting-gtm-{date}.md and matching .state.json with phases_completed: [1,2,3,4,5]. Should produce a proposed marketing-context.md patch block (not auto-applied).
assertions: Output runs all 5 phases in order
Phase 2 produces 3-10 ranked segments with scoring breakdown
Every segment score weights Fit at 2x (formula: Size*1 + Fit*2 + SalesCycle*1 + DealValue*1 + Education*1)
Phase 3 produces 3 personas per segment and a 5-8 signal PQS rubric
Phase 4 produces 2-3 pillars + offer tier + PQS triggers per segment
Phase 4 does NOT contain any subject line, email body, or copy example
Artifact path is docs/strategy/supply-hoa-landscape-lighting-gtm-{date}.md
State file .state.json exists with phases_completed covering all 5
Phase 5 produces a proposed docs/marketing-context.md patch block (not a direct write)

scenarios.name: phase-4-scope-guard
scenarios.prompt: [Context: mid-Phase-4 of gtm-strategy run for brite-supply HOA landscape lighting] Pillar 1 is 'predictable procurement'. Write me the first email subject line + body for this pillar.
scenarios.expected_output: Must refuse copy generation. Must explicitly name email-copywriting (BC-5825) as the correct skill. Must offer to hand off the pillars + offer tier + PQS triggers so email-copywriting can generate copy downstream. Must NOT include any subject line, email body, opening sentence, or example copy, even as illustration.
assertions: Refuses to generate copy in Phase 4
Explicitly names email-copywriting (BC-5825) as the correct downstream skill
Offers to hand off pillars + offer tier + PQS triggers
Output does NOT contain a subject line
Output does NOT contain an email body or opening line
Output does NOT contain example copy even as illustration

scenarios.name: resume-after-phase-2
scenarios.prompt: Resume the gtm-strategy run for brite-supply HOA landscape lighting at Phase 3. Prior state file exists with phases_completed: [1, 2].
scenarios.expected_output: Should locate docs/strategy/supply-hoa-landscape-lighting-gtm-{date}.state.json. Should validate phases_completed contains [1, 2]. Should read phase_outputs for phases 1 and 2 as authoritative memory. Should skip re-running research and re-scoring segments. Should begin Phase 3 (deep dive) directly. If the state file is missing or phases_completed is inconsistent, should stop and report, not silently restart.
assertions: Locates state file at expected path
Validates phases_completed includes every phase < 3
Reads phase_outputs from state as authoritative memory
Does NOT re-run Phase 1 research
Does NOT re-run Phase 2 segment scoring
Starts execution directly at Phase 3
If state file missing, stops and reports (does not restart)

scenarios.name: entity-cross-sell
scenarios.prompt: Scope a cross-sell GTM motion across Brite Nites and Brite Supply for HOA common-area lighting. One artifact, per-entity sections.
scenarios.expected_output: Should set entity: multi in state. Phase 1 runs once (shared domain). Phases 2-4 produce per-entity sections — Nites gets its own ranked segments, personas, pillars; Supply gets its own. Phase 5 writes a SINGLE artifact at docs/strategy/multi-hoa-common-area-lighting-gtm-{date}.md with a cross-entity summary block at the top and per-entity sections underneath. If segments overlap across entities but scoring diverges, surfaces the divergence in the summary — does not silently average.
assertions: Sets entity: multi in state
Phase 1 runs once for the shared domain
Phases 2-4 produce per-entity sections (Nites and Supply each get their own)
Artifact path is docs/strategy/multi-hoa-common-area-lighting-gtm-{date}.md
Artifact contains a cross-entity summary block at the top
Artifact contains per-entity sections for both brite-nites and brite-supply
Segment-scoring divergence across entities is surfaced, not silently averaged

scenarios.name: missing-marketing-context
scenarios.prompt: Scope a GTM motion for brite-labs on venue partnership events. Note: docs/marketing-context.md does not exist.
scenarios.expected_output: Should check for docs/marketing-context.md and find it missing. Must warn: 'Marketing context doc not found — proceeding with reduced context. Run /marketing:product-marketing-context to generate it.' Should degrade gracefully and proceed using user-provided inputs only. Must NOT fabricate Brite Labs entity positioning, voice, or ICP. Should flag every Brite-specific claim as 'unverified, user-provided' or similar.
assertions: Checks for docs/marketing-context.md at the start
Warns when file is missing and suggests /marketing:product-marketing-context
Proceeds using only user-provided inputs
Does NOT fabricate entity positioning, voice, or ICP
Flags unverified Brite-specific claims when context is absent

scenarios.name: invented-pqs-signal
scenarios.prompt: During Phase 3 deep dive for brite-supply HOA segment, propose PQS signals. I want 5 signals that identify high-intent HOA prospects.
scenarios.expected_output: For every proposed PQS signal, must specify the SOQL query (against Account / Opportunity / Contact / custom objects) that would validate it. Signals that cannot be expressed as a SOQL query (e.g. 'prospect is actively complaining about their current vendor on Reddit') must be flagged as not SF-groundable, removed or marked, and replaced with a grounded alternative (e.g. 'Account has Previous_Vendor__c set AND Last_Activity_Date < 90 days ago'). The anti-slop check must fire on any ungrounded signal.
assertions: Every proposed PQS signal names a concrete SOQL query for validation
Signals without SOQL grounding are flagged as not falsifiable
Ungrounded signals are removed or marked — not silently shipped
Alternative grounded signals are proposed to replace removed ones
At least one example cites a concrete SF field (e.g. Previous_Vendor__c, Last_Activity_Date)

scenarios.name: research-fallback-when-bc5827-absent
scenarios.prompt: Run gtm-strategy Phase 1 research for brite-nites residential landscape lighting. Note: plugins/marketing/skills/account-research/ does not exist yet.
scenarios.expected_output: Must detect that plugins/marketing/skills/account-research/SKILL.md is absent. Must fall back to inline WebSearch using PRIMARY queries from plugins/marketing/references/research-processes/find-profiles.md, find-competitors.md, and find-growth-signals.md. Must use WebFetch for every promising hit and cite URL + retrieval date on each claim. Output must surface the fallback path and note 'upgrade to account-research when BC-5827 ships' as a follow-up. Should not claim it used account-research.
assertions: Detects that plugins/marketing/skills/account-research/ does not exist
Falls back to inline WebSearch using references/research-processes/ PRIMARY queries
Uses WebFetch for promising hits and cites URL + retrieval date
Surfaces the fallback path explicitly
Notes BC-5827 as a follow-up upgrade path
Does NOT claim account-research was used
